meaningfulAssertions: sign-out closes a pending connection and withholds its late protected definition
a slower previous connection cannot replace the current attempt
unmount closes a pending connection without installing a late transport
an authentication failure closes a pending client and fences its late completion
same-principal refresh replaces an aborted content read with a fresh observation
a refreshed different principal clears protected output and closes the old connection
overlapping refresh ignores an obsolete AUTH_REFRESHED completion and retains the successful current connection
fresh protected-read FORBIDDEN clears previously authorized history even while the host JWT remains accepted
